about.title: About Us
about.missionBody: gigSEVA is dedicated to connecting skilled workers with those who need their expertise. Our mission is to create a seamless, reliable, and efficient marketplace for services, empowering individuals to grow their businesses and find quality assistance whenever needed.
about.step1Body: Describe the service you need and your location.
about.step2Body: Experienced workers will reach out to help you.
about.step3Body: Quality service delivered right to your doorstep.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.footer: Privacy is our priority at gigSEVA.

infoCollect.title: 1. Information We Collect
infoCollect.body: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, and location data when you use our services.

infoUse.title: 2. How We Use Information
infoUse.body: We use the information to connect job seekers with service providers, improve our app experience, and communicate with you about your account and our services.

infoSharing.title: 3. Sharing of Information
infoSharing.body: We share your contact information and location with other users only when necessary to facilitate a service connection (e.g., sharing a worker's location with a client).

location.title: 4. Location Services
location.body: Our app requires access to your location to find nearby services. You can manage location permissions in your device settings.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access or disclosure.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing and using the gigSEVA application, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the app.

accounts.title: 2. User Accounts
accounts.body: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. Any activity under your account is your responsibility. You must be at least 18 years old to use this service.

serviceRules.title: 3. Service Rules
serviceRules.body: Workers must provide accurate information regarding their skills and experience. Job seekers must provide valid service requests. We reserve the right to suspend accounts that violate our community guidelines.

payments.title: 4. Payments
payments.body: gigSEVA provides a platform for connection. Payment terms are negotiated directly between the worker and the client unless specified otherwise. We are not responsible for payment disputes.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: gigSEVA shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use our services.

faq.postJobQuestion: How do I post a job?
faq.postJobAnswer: Tap the '+' floating button on the home screen to start creating your job post.
faq.contactWorkerQuestion: How do I contact a worker?
faq.contactWorkerAnswer: View the job details and use the 'Chat' or 'Call' buttons to connect directly.
faq.becomeWorkerQuestion: How do I become a worker?
faq.becomeWorkerAnswer: Go to your Profile and tap 'Become a Worker' to set up your professional profile.
